name: apple-icloud-mcp
description: Apple Music playlists and library, iCloud Calendar, Contacts and Mail, Apple Maps, WeatherKit and iTunes search — through Apple's web services, so it runs anywhere. Unofficial; not affiliated with Apple.

apple_team_id.title: Apple Team ID
apple_team_id.description: Your Apple Developer Team ID (10 characters). Needed for Apple Music (official API), Apple Maps and WeatherKit.

apple_key_id.title: Apple Key ID
apple_key_id.description: Key ID of a private key created in Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Keys with Media Services (MusicKit), MapKit JS and/or WeatherKit enabled.

apple_private_key.title: Apple private key (.p8 contents)
apple_private_key.description: Contents of that key's .p8 file (PEM; one-line values with \n escapes and base64 are accepted).

apple_weatherkit_service_id.title: WeatherKit Services ID
apple_weatherkit_service_id.description: WeatherKit only: the Services ID registered for WeatherKit (e.g. com.example.weather).

apple_music_user_token.title: Apple Music user token
apple_music_user_token.description: Music User Token for your library (official API), from a one-time MusicKit sign-in: `npx apple-icloud-mcp music-auth`. Without the Apple Developer key, ask the owner for a developer token (music-auth --print-developer-token) and run it with APPLE_MUSIC_DEVELOPER_TOKEN set. Lasts ~6 months.

apple_music_web_user_token.title: Apple Music web session token (media-user-token cookie)
apple_music_web_user_token.description: Opt-in web-player mode (no developer account needed; unlocks rename/delete/remove/reorder): the media-user-token cookie from a signed-in music.apple.com tab.

icloud_username.title: Apple ID email
icloud_username.description: Your Apple ID email, for iCloud Calendar, Contacts and Mail.

icloud_app_password.title: iCloud app-specific password
icloud_app_password.description: An app-specific password from appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (NOT your Apple ID password).

icloud_mail_address.title: iCloud Mail address
icloud_mail_address.description: Your @icloud.com address, only if your Apple ID email is not an iCloud address (needed for Mail).

apple_write_mode.title: Write mode
apple_write_mode.description: "none" = read-only tools; "additive" = also create/append, never modify, delete or send; "all" = everything (default). Unrecognized values fail closed to "none".

apple_services.title: Enabled services
apple_services.description: Comma-separated services to enable (music, calendar, contacts, mail, maps, weather, itunes). Default: all.

display_tz.title: Time zone
display_tz.description: IANA time zone (e.g. America/New_York) for displayed times and for dates you give without an offset. Set this on a hosted server, which runs in UTC.

tools.name: apple_healthcheck
tools.description: Check which Apple services (Apple Music, iCloud Calendar, Contacts, Mail, Apple Maps, WeatherKit, iTunes) are configured and reachable.

tools.name: apple_music_search_catalog
tools.description: Search Apple Music's catalog by text for songs, albums, artists, playlists, music videos or stations.

tools.name: apple_music_get_catalog_items
tools.description: Look up Apple Music catalog songs, albums, artists, playlists, music videos or stations by id — or songs/music videos by ISRC, albums by UPC.

tools.name: apple_music_get_charts
tools.description: Get Apple Music's top charts (most played songs, albums, playlists, music videos) for a storefront, optionally for one genre.

tools.name: apple_music_list_playlists
tools.description: List the playlists in your Apple Music library (alphabetical), or the contents of one playlist folder (folders and playlists).

tools.name: apple_music_get_playlist
tools.description: Read one playlist — a library playlist (p.…) or a catalog playlist (pl.…) — with its tracks in order.

tools.name: apple_music_list_folders
tools.description: List the playlist folders in your Apple Music library: the top level, or the sub-folders of one folder.

tools.name: apple_music_search_library
tools.description: Search YOUR Apple Music library (not the whole catalog) by text for songs, albums, artists, playlists or music videos.

tools.name: apple_music_list_library
tools.description: List what is in your Apple Music library: all songs, albums, artists or music videos (alphabetical, paged), or recently-added items.

tools.name: apple_music_get_history
tools.description: Your recent Apple Music listening: recently-played (albums, playlists, stations), recently-played-tracks (songs), recent-stations, or heavy-rotation.

tools.name: apple_music_get_recommendations
tools.description: Your personal Apple Music recommendations ("Made for You", "Recently Played" and similar groups), each with its title and the albums, playlists or stations in it (catalog ids).

tools.name: apple_music_get_replay
tools.description: Apple Music Replay: your top songs, albums and artists for the latest Replay year, or for a given year (with play counts where Apple provides them).

tools.name: apple_music_get_ratings
tools.description: Whether you have loved or disliked songs, albums, playlists, music videos or stations — catalog or library ids — returning love, dislike or none per id.

tools.name: apple_music_create_playlist
tools.description: Create a new playlist in your Apple Music library, optionally with tracks (up to 500 catalog or library song ids; added 100 at a time), a description, a folder and public visibility (not in APPLE_WRITE_MODE=additive).

tools.name: apple_music_add_playlist_tracks
tools.description: Append songs (up to 500 catalog or library ids) to the end of one of your library playlists.

tools.name: apple_music_create_folder
tools.description: Create a playlist folder in your Apple Music library, at the top level or inside another folder.

tools.name: apple_music_add_to_library
tools.description: Add catalog songs, albums, playlists or music videos to your Apple Music library by catalog id (up to 100 per type).

tools.name: apple_music_add_favorites
tools.description: Mark catalog songs, albums, playlists, artists or music videos as favorites (the star in Apple Music; favorite songs go to your Favorite Songs playlist), by catalog id, up to 100 per type.

tools.name: apple_music_set_rating
tools.description: Set your rating on a song, album, playlist, music video or station (catalog or library id): love, dislike, or none to clear it.

tools.name: apple_music_update_playlist
tools.description: Rename one of your Apple Music library playlists, change its description, or make it public/private.

tools.name: apple_music_remove_playlist_tracks
tools.description: Remove tracks from one of your library playlists by library track id and/or 1-based position (from apple_music_get_playlist).

tools.name: apple_music_reorder_playlist
tools.description: Reorder one of your library playlists: move tracks, sort (name, artist, album, release date, duration, date added), reverse, dedupe (keep the first copy of each song), or replace with a complete new order of its track ids (can drop tracks).

tools.name: apple_music_move_playlist
tools.description: Move one of your library playlists into a playlist folder, or back to the top level ("root").

tools.name: apple_music_delete_playlist
tools.description: Delete one of your library playlists (songs stay in your library).

tools.name: apple_music_remove_from_library
tools.description: Remove songs, albums, music videos or playlists from your Apple Music library by LIBRARY id (i.…, l.…, p.… from apple_music_list_library / apple_music_search_library), up to 50 at a time; the preview names each item.

tools.name: apple_music_remove_favorites
tools.description: Remove the favorite (star) from catalog songs, albums, playlists, artists or music videos, by catalog id, up to 100 per type.

tools.name: apple_calendar_list_calendars
tools.description: List your iCloud calendars (event calendars only): id, name, color, whether you can add events to it, whether it is shared (shared: with you by someone else; sharedByYou: by you with others), and which one new events go into by default.

tools.name: apple_calendar_list_events
tools.description: List iCloud Calendar events (appointments, meetings) in a date window, recurring events expanded into occurrences, sorted by start.

tools.name: apple_calendar_search_events
tools.description: Search iCloud Calendar events by text (case-insensitive match in title, location or notes) within a date window: fromDate (default today; may be in the past) + toDate or daysAhead (default 30), max 366 days.

tools.name: apple_calendar_get_event
tools.description: Get one iCloud Calendar event in full (notes untruncated, attendees, alerts, recurrence rule in plain English) by the id list/search returned.

tools.name: apple_calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create an iCloud Calendar event: title, startDate/endDate (timed default 1 hour; all-day endDate = last day), location, notes, url, alarms, recurrence, attendees.

tools.name: apple_calendar_update_event
tools.description: Change an iCloud Calendar event: title, startDate/endDate, isAllDay, location, notes, url ("" clears), alarms, attendees (full new list), calendar (moves it).

tools.name: apple_calendar_delete_event
tools.description: Delete an iCloud Calendar event. Recurring: span thisEvent (default; the one occurrence an "#occ=" id names), futureEvents (it and all later ones) or allEvents (the whole series).

tools.name: apple_calendar_find_free_time
tools.description: Find free time in your iCloud calendars: open slots per day within working hours (workdayStart/workdayEnd, default 09:00–17:00, weekdays only by default) at least minDurationMinutes long (default 30).

tools.name: apple_contacts_search
tools.description: Search the user's iCloud Contacts (address book) by name, nickname, company, job title, email, or phone number digits — optionally only within one contact group.

tools.name: apple_contacts_get
tools.description: Get one iCloud contact in full by id (from apple_contacts_search): names, organization, job title, emails, phones, postal addresses and URLs — each with its label and an entryId that apple_contacts_update can target — birthday, note, the…

tools.name: apple_contacts_list_groups
tools.description: List the contact groups in iCloud Contacts (e.g. Family, Work): each group's id, name and member count.

tools.name: apple_contacts_create
tools.description: Create a new contact in iCloud Contacts. Needs a givenName, familyName or organization; optional middleName, nickname, department, jobTitle, note, birthday (YYYY-MM-DD, or --MM-DD without a year), and lists of emails, phones, urls and po…

tools.name: apple_contacts_update
tools.description: Edit an existing iCloud contact in place. Scalar fields (givenName, familyName, middleName, nickname, organization, department, jobTitle, note, birthday) replace the current value; "" clears it.

tools.name: apple_contacts_delete
tools.description: Permanently delete one contact from iCloud Contacts (on every device) by id.

tools.name: apple_mail_list_mailboxes
tools.description: List the iCloud Mail mailboxes (folders): path, name, special use (inbox, sent, drafts, trash, junk, archive) and, by default, message and unread counts.

tools.name: apple_mail_search
tools.description: Search emails in one iCloud Mail mailbox (default INBOX) by sender, recipient, subject, full text, received date range, unread and flagged state.

tools.name: apple_mail_get_message
tools.description: Read one iCloud Mail message by uid (from apple_mail_search): headers (from, to, cc, reply-to, date, subject, message-id), the body as plain text (HTML converted to readable text when there is no text part), a truncated flag, and attachm…

tools.name: apple_mail_download_attachment
tools.description: Download one iCloud Mail attachment as an embedded binary resource by its 1-based index from apple_mail_get_message. Reads without marking it read; defaults to 10 MiB, maximum 20 MiB.

tools.name: apple_mail_send
tools.description: Send a plain-text email from your iCloud Mail address (to/cc/bcc, subject, body; no attachments).

tools.name: apple_mail_update_flags
tools.description: Mark iCloud Mail messages read or unread, and flag or unflag them, by uid (1–100 uids from apple_mail_search, one mailbox).

tools.name: apple_mail_move
tools.description: Move iCloud Mail messages (1–100 uids from apple_mail_search, one mailbox) to another mailbox: a path from apple_mail_list_mailboxes or an alias (inbox, archive, trash, junk, sent, drafts).

tools.name: apple_maps_geocode
tools.description: Turn an address or place name into coordinates with Apple Maps (geocoding).

tools.name: apple_maps_reverse_geocode
tools.description: Find the street address at a latitude/longitude with Apple Maps (reverse geocoding) — e.g. "where is 37.33,-122.01?".

tools.name: apple_maps_search
tools.description: Search Apple Maps for places: businesses, points of interest, addresses, landmarks (e.g. "coffee", "EV charger", "Golden Gate Bridge").

tools.name: apple_maps_directions
tools.description: Driving, walking or cycling directions between two places with Apple Maps (addresses or "lat,lng").

tools.name: apple_maps_etas
tools.description: Travel time and distance from one point to up to 10 destinations at once with Apple Maps — driving with live traffic, transit, walking or cycling (e.g. "which of these stores is closest by car?").

tools.name: apple_maps_lookup_place
tools.description: Look up Apple Maps places by place id — the id field from apple_maps_search, apple_maps_geocode or apple_maps_reverse_geocode results — 1 to 50 at once.

tools.name: apple_maps_snapshot_url
tools.description: Make a signed link to a static Apple Maps image (PNG): centred on an address or "lat,lng", and/or with pins (each with an optional label, colour and one-character glyph; the map fits the pins when no center is given).

tools.name: apple_weather_get
tools.description: Weather forecast for a place from Apple Weather (WeatherKit): current conditions, hourly (up to 240 h), daily (up to 10 days), next-hour rain, severe-weather alerts (need countryCode).

tools.name: apple_weather_get_alert
tools.description: Get one severe-weather alert's full official text from Apple Weather (WeatherKit), unmodified, by its id (the alerts[].id from apple_weather_get called with countryCode).

tools.name: apple_itunes_search
tools.description: Search Apple's iTunes Store catalog — songs, albums, artists, podcasts and podcast episodes, audiobooks, apps and ebooks — with no Apple account or key.

tools.name: apple_itunes_lookup
tools.description: Look up iTunes Store items (no Apple account or key) by ids — 1–200 trackId/collectionId/artistId values, e.g. from apple_itunes_search or an Apple Music link — or by one UPC/EAN (album), ISBN (book) or bundleId (app).

tools.name: apple_charts_get
tools.description: Apple's current top charts (no Apple account or key): most-played songs, albums, music videos and playlists on Apple Music; top podcasts, trending podcast episodes and top subscriber channels; top free/paid apps and books; top audiobooks.
